parties.petitioner: Dlf Ltd. (Formerly Known As Dlf Universal Ltd) And Anr.

summary: Enforcement of foreign currency arbitral award; two issues: (1) correct date for foreign exchange rate determination in conversion to INR, (2) conversion date when partial deposit made during objections; twin principles established: (a) date of enforceability (finality post-objections dismissal) governs conversion under Forasol principle for non-deposited amount, (b) date of court deposit applicable for amount deposited pending objections per Renusagar; award dated 12.05.2004 became final after High Court dismissal of revision on 01.07.2014; Rs.8 crore deposit occurred on 22.10.2010 per consent order dated 15.10.2010; High Court upheld 01.07.2014 as conversion date ignoring partial deposit timing; Supreme Court corrected approach by applying different conversion dates for deposited and non-deposited portions.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment reversed; conversion rate for Rs.8 crore deposit fixed at rate on date of deposit (22.10.2010), balance amount at rate on award finality date (01.07.2014).
